scope: fixed seven-bit complete-enumeration and symmetry-correctness pilot
equivalent_suite_reason: The WDSat corpus is a Boolean solver-stage contract. This pilot instead enumerates exact point multisets on one fixed curve and audits coordinate-invariant lifting. It does not modify WDSat or claim solver/DLP performance. All three variants run identical supports and every group target; seed holdouts are included.
targets: all 116 rational group points, including identity and zero-yield cases
enumeration_floor: binom(B+2,3): minimum visits for explicit enumeration of every point multiset, not a lower bound for arbitrary PDP solvers
counter_semantics: field_multiply includes internal square/inverse multiplication; ec_add includes identity and doubling calls; component counters are nested and must not be summed
execution_order: deterministic shuffle by case ID and repetition
correctness_gate: every variant must return the exact ordered-oracle point-multiset catalogue; every answer must verify; orbit counts and transport must pass
falsification: any mismatch rejects the entire run; smaller orbit counts alone cannot establish a solver gain
future_promotion: The separate specification's 20 percent complete-cost gate requires actual solver runs on at least two field sizes; this single-field enumeration pilot cannot pass it.
